Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Active Ability: Time Erase

When Devil Boss uses his ability "Time Erase", he gives every unit on the map a 50% damage boost while heavily slowing units down (duration is 8-9 seconds).



Trivia

  • Devil Boss is one of the first units that increases the vulnerability of enemies along with Blackhair, followed up by Shadow Sorcerer and Cursed King
  • Devil Boss Time Erase causes all enemies to move so slowly that they're basically frozen, which is why people usually call his ability a "TS" instead of slow.
